game.name: Bioshock 2 (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: BioShock 2 is a first-person shooter for Xbox 360. It takes place 10 years after the first game and puts you in the role of a Protector. As a Protector, you must traverse the streets of Rapture, the sunken city, and attempt to finally gain your freedom. To do so, you'll have to face many enemies and make decisions that will affect the fate of the entire city. But the great novelty of this episode is the appearance of a multiplayer mode for 10 participants.
